Cost: 5,000eb (Luxury)
Type: Neuralware
Install: Hospital
Humanity Loss: 14 (4d6)
Option Slots: uses 3

Borgware. Requires a Neuroport Cyberdeck Port and paired Cyberarms. Takes 3 Neuralware Option Slots and 2 Cyberarm Option Slots on each of the paired arms. The Neuroport Cyberdeck Port's range goes to 80m/yds for Quickhacking and 40m/yds for reaching non-Neuroport NET Architectures. It also works as two installations of Ex-Disk and one of Self-ICE, and lets the user install Bodyweight Coatings as though they were a Full Body Conversion. Any Overheat quickhack on the user is reduced to Mildly on Fire (2 HP a turn) by its mobile cooling. It can't be concealed and is obvious without clothing over it.

Foundry notes:

  • Typed as Neuralware, taking its 3 Neuralware slots; the 2 Cyberarm slots it needs in each arm are not tracked by the sheet.
  • Counts as Borgware for Maximum Humanity Loss; the sheet doesn't track that, so apply it by hand.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Cyberware > Borgware).
